turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hey, nice to hear from you. How are you?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My dog pulls on the lead so hard I've nearly been dragged into a hedge. Twice.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Ouch. Would you rather try a front clip harness to make walks easier right now, or sign up for some training classes to fix the habit?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Can you hang on? I have to talk to someone here. I'll tell you when I'm back.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Is the neighbour's car still blocking ours?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: No, he moved it this morning.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Alex, the taxi to the trailhead is booked for six.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Six in the morning? On a Saturday?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: You said you wanted to beat the crowds.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: I say a lot of things after dinner.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Do you want me to wake you at half five, or will you set an alarm?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Knock on my door. Loudly. And have coffee ready or I'm not moving.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Coffee in a flask, I promise.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Are we done with the paint or should I keep it?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'm back, sorry for the wait.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: No problem. The pulling problem. Are we going with a harness or classes?
